raw_s2_boxes.definition: CSV boxes + every V1_cyan blue/green component >= 50 px (Task B raw S2, no filtering, no dedup)

automated_full_dataset.rock_component_coverage_definition: V1 mask components >= 50 px whose bbox lies >= 50% inside at least one box of the set

splitter.rule: largest instance recovery with over-split rate <= 0.05 on known single rocks

visibility.caveat: in-sample on Task B assistant review (small n); evaluated out of sample by the Task C review
visibility.rule: keep if edge >= t_e OR contrast >= t_c; absolute (grey levels) or scene-relative (edge / median ground gradient, contrast / ground grey-level std); maximise Youden J subject to keeping >= 0.85 of visible rocks

review_after_task_c.denominators: per stratum = assessed items in that stratum; strata are not population-weighted
review_after_task_c.reviewer: AI assistant visual assessment (NOT human validation)

valid_mask_annotations_weighted_estimate.note: stratum rates weighted by VALID population counts; small n, no confidence interval
